{{Expand section|date=November 2023}}
The '''Hellenic  Mathematical Society (HMS)''' ({{langx|el|Ελληνική Μαθηματική Εταιρεία}}) is a learned society which promotes the study of [[mathematics]] in [[Greece]]. It was founded in 1918 in [[Athens]],<ref>{{Cite web |last=MENSA |first=Nikolas Demiridis for Greek |title=Greek Mathematical Society « MENSA Greece |url=https://gifted.mensa.org.gr/organizers/co-organizers/greek-mathematical-society.html?lang=en |access-date=2025-04-28 |language=en-US}}</ref> and publishes the ''Bulletin of the Hellenic Mathematical Society'' (Δελτίο της Ελληνικής Μαθηματικής Εταιρίας)<ref>{{Cite web | title = The HMS Bulletin | url = https://bulletin.math.uoc.gr/ | access-date=2022-09-09 | website = Bulletin of the Hellenic Mathematical Society}}</ref> among other research and educational publications. It is a member of the [[European Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web | title = Members of the European Mathematical Society | url = https://www.emis.de/member-societies.html | access-date=2022-09-09 | website = Member Societies and Institutional Members of the EMS}}</ref> The HMS also organizes national math competitions.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://hms.gr/?q=competitions/home | title=Ελληνική Μαθηματική Εταιρεία }}</ref>

== Objectives ==
Amongst the main objectives of the HMS are:<ref>{{Cite web |title=Second Congress of Greek Mathematicians SCGM-2022, July 4–8, 2022, Athens, Greece |url=https://math.uoi.gr/images/pdf/news/2nd_announcement_scgm_22.pdf |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220705184442/https://math.uoi.gr/images/pdf/news/2nd_announcement_scgm_22.pdf |archive-date=July 5, 2022 |access-date=March 3, 2025 |website=University of Ioannina, Department of Mathematics}}</ref>

* the advancement of mathematics;  
* the fostering of free exchange of information between mathematicians, scientists and the society at large; 
* the substantial and continuous improvement of mathematical education and the advancement of general education; 
* to inform Greek mathematicians on recent progress made in science and technology and offer them practical assistance in matters which may occur during their work at school. 

== Members ==
As of July 2022, the HMS has 12,000 members and 39 regional branches across Greece.<ref>{{Cite web |title=About HELLENIC MATHEMATICAL SOCIETY {{!}} SEEMOUS 2020 |url=https://seemous2020.auth.gr/abouthms |access-date=2025-04-28 |website=seemous2020.auth.gr}}</ref>
